channel.title: The Adgent blog
channel.description: Field notes on Meta and Google Ads: diagnostics, audits and honest reads on what the numbers mean.

item.title: When does November really peak? 11.11 and Black Friday in Türkiye
item.description: Compare 11.11 and Black Friday in Türkiye using 2023–2025 search trends, 2024–2025 marketplace transactions and a matched 30-page Meta ad panel.

item.title: Why Performance Max isn't spending your full budget
item.description: Performance Max not spending your budget? It is usually not the budget: bid targets and Quality Score are likelier. A diagnostic ranked by likelihood.

item.title: Why is my Meta ROAS dropping?
item.description: Meta ROAS dropping? Most drops are signal problems, not campaign problems. Check tracking, scaling, saturation, fatigue and attribution, in that order.

item.title: Why did my CPA suddenly jump? What to check first
item.description: A CPA spike is usually one of four things: a tracking break, a learning reset, auction pressure or creative fatigue. Check them in that order before you pause.

item.title: Is Performance Max cannibalizing your branded search?
item.description: Performance Max often takes credit for branded demand you would win for free, inflating its ROAS while adding little. How to spot it, stop it and measure it.

item.title: Meta vs Google Ads: which platform for your first $10k?
item.description: Google Ads captures demand people already have; Meta creates it. Which to start with depends on whether people search for what you sell. A side-by-side.

item.title: How to audit a Performance Max campaign (the black box)
item.description: Performance Max hides where the money goes. The checks that open the black box, ranked by impact: brand-spend detection and tracking first.

item.title: CBO vs ABO vs Advantage+: which budget model in 2026?
item.description: Pick by what you are buying: ABO to test each option fairly, CBO to scale known winners, Advantage+ when you trust your signal and want Meta to run it.

item.title: Can AI run your ad account?
item.description: AI can run the daily reads, diagnosis and drafting across Meta and Google Ads. See the work it can own and the business calls that stay with the buyer.

item.title: Frequency is a lagging indicator. Watch CPM.
item.description: By the time frequency says your audience is tired, your cost already moved. Why the CPM curve, read with CTR, calls creative fatigue days earlier.

item.title: Placement drift: the leak hiding in your average
item.description: A blended 3.8× ROAS can hide a placement returning 1.1× on a fifth of your budget. How placement drift happens and how to find the leak before you cut.

item.title: How much of your ad budget is wasted (and how to find it)
item.description: WordStream's study of 15,666 Google Ads accounts puts typical waste near a third of budget. Six named leaks, and how to price each for your account.

item.title: What is an AI media buyer? A plain-language guide
item.description: An AI media buyer reads ad accounts like a senior strategist, explains what changed and why, then carries the next move forward.

item.title: Why Adgent leads with the verdict
item.description: Conclusion first, evidence underneath, nothing you didn't need. The design rule behind every Adgent verdict, with one live account as the worked example.

item.title: Why your Google Ads CPA rose: the August 2026 Target CPA change
item.description: On 17 August 2026 Google made budget-limited campaigns spend up to their Target CPA or ROAS. If you were beating your target, your CPA rose. The read.

item.title: How to choose an AI media buying tool
item.description: AI ad tools split into four categories: creative generation, bid automation, analysis and diagnostics, and DSPs. A neutral map, and how to pick by bottleneck.

item.title: Can AI audit your ad accounts?
item.description: AI audits ad accounts well for wasted spend, tracking gaps and signal quality, and hits a ceiling on strategy and context. Where the line sits, and why.

item.title: Google Ads account structure in 2026 (and how to audit yours)
item.description: In 2026 Google Ads structure is about signal, not manual control: single-theme ad groups, a brand split, 30+ conversions a month per campaign. Four checks.

item.title: The Meta Ads account audit: the ten checks that recover spend
item.description: Audit a Meta Ads account in order of recoverable spend: verify pixel and CAPI signal first, then attribution, CBO leakage, placement drift and creative fatigue.

item.title: You can't put a senior on every account. You can put a senior read on every account.
item.description: Give every client account a senior read on its own data, with ranked decisions, finished reports and brand context that carries forward.

item.title: How to audit a Google Ads account: 12-point checklist
item.description: A Google Ads audit ordered by recoverable spend: tracking first, then search terms, placements, bid strategy and pacing. Twelve checks, and how often.

item.title: AI media buyer vs Performance Max vs dashboard: which do you need?
item.description: Three tools, three jobs: dashboards report, Performance Max optimizes the auction, and an AI media buyer reasons across the account.

item.title: The 7-day window is lying to you before noon
item.description: Meta's 7-day click window rewrites yesterday's ROAS for a week. Which metrics are final within hours, which are still being written, and when to decide.

item.title: How to scale a winner without breaking it
item.description: Adding budget to a winning Meta campaign without a learning reset: why the size of each step matters more than the final number, and when to go sideways.

item.title: Meta says 4.2×, Google says 3.1×. Both are right.
item.description: Meta and Google ROAS use different windows, credit models and conversion definitions. How to build a comparability boundary before you move budget.
